title: Pixtt Suir Mindrider
summary: Survive repeated multi-target curse bursts while holding Mindrider inside her room.
overview: Survive repeated multi-target curse bursts while holding Mindrider inside her room.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Call each health threshold so healers and support can respond to the curse burst.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At80%,60%,40%,20% and 10% health, Mindrider casts Curse of the Ikaav four times on randomly selected hated targets.
Her scripted modifiers reduce slashing damage and increase archery damage.
Crossing the room boundary returns her and clears hate; thirty seconds out of combat restores full health and rearms the thresholds.

notes: Approval E410. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
